function _futtat_optimalizalt_softmax(arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus, x::AbstractArray)
    ax = ndims(x)
    x32 = convert(Array{Float32}, x)
    x_max = maximum(x32; dims=ax)
    unnormalized = exp.(x32 .- x_max)
    denom = sum(unnormalized; dims=ax)
    return unnormalized ./ denom
end

function _attend(
    arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus,
    q::AbstractArray,
    k::AbstractArray,
    v::AbstractArray;
    q_k_dot_precision::DotPrecision,
    logits_dtype::DataType,
    logits_scale::Float64,
    bias::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing},
    mask::Union{Mask, Nothing},
    weights_v_dot_precision::DotPrecision,
    q_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing,
    k_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing
)
    logits = arch.asadi_pim(
        arch.salo_asic,
        arch.rt_kernel,
        arch.pic_gyorsito,
        arch.aimc_tomb,
        arch.alpha_tensor,
        arch.kvantum_hid,
        arch.adaptiv_kvantalas,
        "...qhd,...khd->...hqk",
        q, k;
        precision=q_k_dot_precision
    )

    logits = convert(Array{logits_dtype}, logits)
    logits = logits .* logits_scale
    if bias !== nothing
        logits = logits .+ bias
    end
    if mask !== nothing
        q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2)
        k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
        mask_arr = as_array(mask, q_len, k_len)
        mask_value = -Inf32
        logits = ifelse.(mask_arr, logits, mask_value)
    end
    
    weights = _futtat_optimalizalt_softmax(arch, logits)
    weights = convert(Array{eltype(v)}, weights)
    
    out = arch.asadi_pim(
        arch.salo_asic,
        arch.rt_kernel,
        arch.pic_gyorsito,
        arch.aimc_tomb,
        arch.alpha_tensor,
        arch.kvantum_hid,
        arch.adaptiv_kvantalas,
        "...hqk,...khd->...qhd",
        weights, v;
        precision=weights_v_dot_precision
    )

    out = convert(Array{eltype(q)}, out)
    return out
end

function einsum(subscript::String, arrays::AbstractArray...)
    if subscript == "...qhd,...khd->...hqk"
        return compute_attention_scores(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    elseif subscript == "...hqk,...khd->...qhd"
        return compute_attention_output(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    else
        error("Unsupported einsum operation: $subscript")
    end
end

function _leading_shape(x::AbstractArray, last_nd::Int)
    nd = ndims(x)
    if nd < last_nd
        error("Tensor has fewer than $(last_nd) dims")
    end
    return Tuple(size(x)[1:nd-last_nd])
end

function _prod_shape(t::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    p = 1
    for v in t
        p *= v
    end
    return p
end

function compute_attention_scores(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(q) < 3 || ndims(k) < 3
        error("q and k must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(q, 3) != _leading_shape(k, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    qh = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    kh = size(k, ndims(k)-1)
    if qh != kh
        error("Head dimension must match between q and k")
    end
    dd = size(q, ndims(q))
    if dd != size(k, ndims(k))
        error("Feature dimension d must match between q and k")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(q, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2)
    k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
    h = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    d = size(q, ndims(q))
    q_ = reshape(q, (B, q_len, h, d))
    k_ = reshape(k, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    q2 = reshape(permutedims(q_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, q_len, d))
    k2 = reshape(permutedims(k_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    scores = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, k_len)
    for i in 1:BH
        scores[i, :, :] = convert(Array{Float32}, q2[i, :, :]) * transpose(convert(Array{Float32}, k2[i, :, :]))
    end
    out = reshape(scores, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., h, q_len, k_len))
end

function compute_attention_output(weights::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(weights) < 3 || ndims(v) < 3
        error("weights and v must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(weights, 3) != _leading_shape(v, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    h1 = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    h2 = size(v, ndims(v)-1)
    if h1 != h2
        error("Head dimension must match between weights and v")
    end
    k1 = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    k2 = size(v, ndims(v)-2)
    if k1 != k2
        error("Key length must match between weights and v")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(weights, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    h = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    q_len = size(weights, ndims(weights)-1)
    k_len = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    d = size(v, ndims(v))
    w_ = reshape(weights, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    v_ = reshape(v, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    w2 = reshape(permutedims(w_, (1, 2, 3, 4)), (BH, q_len, k_len))
    v2 = reshape(permutedims(v_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    out2 = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, d)
    for i in 1:BH
        out2[i, :, :] = convert(Array{Float32}, w2[i, :, :]) * convert(Array{Float32}, v2[i, :, :])
    end
    out = reshape(out2, (B, h, q_len, d))
    out = permutedims(out, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., q_len, h, d))
end

const VALID_DTYPES = (Float32, Float64, Int8, Int32, Int64, Bool)

function remove_invalidly_typed_feats(batch::Dict{String, Any})::Dict{String, Any}
    out = Dict{String, Any}()
    for (k, v) in batch
        if v isa AbstractArray && eltype(v) in VALID_DTYPES
            out[k] = v
        end
    end
    return out
end

function bfloat16_getter(next_getter, value, context)
    if context isa NamedTuple && haskey(context, :original_dtype) && context.original_dtype == Float32
        if value isa AbstractArray && eltype(value) != Float32
            value = convert(Array{Float32}, value)
        end
    end
    return next_getter(value)
end

function bfloat16_context()
    return bfloat16_getter
end

function mask_mean(mask, value; axis=nothing, keepdims=true, eps=1e-10)
    ax = axis === nothing ? collect(1:ndims(value)) : axis
    if ax isa Integer
        ax = (ax,)
    elseif ax isa AbstractVector{<:Integer}
        ax = Tuple(ax)
    elseif !(ax isa Tuple)
        error("axis must be Integer, Vector or Tuple")
    end
    masked = value .* mask
    num = sum(masked; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)
    den = sum(mask; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)
    den = max.(den, eps)
    return num ./ den
end

struct Vec3Array
    x::Array{Float32}
    y::Array{Float32}
    z::Array{Float32}
    function Vec3Array(x, y, z)
        if eltype(x) !== eltype(y) || eltype(y) !== eltype(z)
            error("Type mismatch")
        end
        if size(x) != size(y) || size(y) != size(z)
            error("Shape mismatch")
        end
        new(x, y, z)
    end
end

    return Vec3Array(a.x .+ b.x, a.y .+ b.y, a.z .+ b.z)
end

    return Vec3Array(a.x .- b.x, a.y .- b.y, a.z .- b.z)

    return Vec3Array(-v.x, -v.y, -v.z)
end

    return Vec3Array(v.x, v.y, v.z)
end

function cross(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array)
    x = a.y .* b.z .- a.z .* b.y
    y = a.z .* b.x .- a.x .* b.z
    z = a.x .* b.y .- a.y .* b.x
    return Vec3Array(x, y, z)
end

function dot(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array)
    return a.x .* b.x .+ a.y .* b.y .+ a.z .* b.z
end

function norm(v::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)
    n2 = dot(v, v)
    if epsilon > 0
        n2 = max.(n2, epsilon^2)
    end
    return sqrt.(n2)
end

function norm2(v::Vec3Array)
    return dot(v, v)
end

function normalized(v::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)
    return v ./ norm(v, epsilon)
end

function from_array(a::AbstractArray)

function square_euclidean_distance(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)

    return dist

function dihedral_angle(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, c::Vec3Array, d::Vec3Array)
    v1 = a - b
    v2 = b - c
    v3 = d - c
    c1 = cross(v1, v2)
    c2 = cross(v3, v2)
    c3 = cross(c2, c1)
    v2m = norm(v2)
    return atan.(dot(c3, v2), v2m .* dot(c1, c2))

function transform_ls(x::Array{Float64,2}, y::Array{Float64,2}; allow_reflection::Bool=false, arch::Union{TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus, Nothing}=nothing)::Array{Float64,2}
    if size(x, 2) != 3 || size(y, 2) != 3
        error("x and y must be N x 3")
    end
    if size(x, 1) != size(y, 1)
        error("x and y must have same number of points")
    end
    
    local c
    if arch !== nothing
        c_raw = arch.pic_gyorsito(
            arch.aimc_tomb,
            arch.alpha_tensor,
            arch.kvantum_hid,
            "ij,ik->jk",
            transpose(x), y
        )
        c = convert(Array{Float64}, c_raw)
    else
        c = x' * y
    end
    
    F = svd(c)
    U = F.U
    V = F.V
    R = V * U'
    if !allow_reflection && det(R) < 0
        V[:, end] .*= -1.0
        R = V * U'
    end
    return R
end

function align(; x::Array{Float64,2}, y::Array{Float64,2}, x_indices::Vector{Int}, y_indices::Vector{Int}, arch::Union{TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus, Nothing}=nothing)::Array{Float64,2}
    if length(x_indices) != length(y_indices)
        throw(ArgumentError("Number of indices must match"))
    end
    x_mean = mean(x[x_indices, :]; dims=1)
    y_mean = mean(y[y_indices, :]; dims=1)
    cx = x .- x_mean
    cy = y .- y_mean
    
    R = transform_ls(cx[x_indices, :], cy[y_indices, :], arch=arch)
    
    local tx
    if arch !== nothing
        cx_r_raw = arch.pic_gyorsito(
            arch.aimc_tomb,
            arch.alpha_tensor,
            arch.kvantum_hid,
            "ij,jk->ik",
            cx, R
        )
        tx_raw = convert(Array{Float64}, cx_r_raw)
        tx = tx_raw .+ y_mean
    else
        tx = cx * R .+ y_mean
    end
    
    return tx
end

function deviations_from_coords(decoy::Array{Float64,2}, gt::Array{Float64,2}, align_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing; arch::Union{TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus, Nothing}=nothing)::Vector{Float64}
    if size(decoy) != size(gt)
        throw(ArgumentError("decoy and gt shapes must match"))
    end
    if include_idxs === nothing
        include_idxs = collect(1:size(decoy, 1))
    end
    if align_idxs === nothing
        align_idxs = include_idxs
    end
    aligned = align(x=decoy, y=gt, x_indices=align_idxs, y_indices=align_idxs, arch=arch)
    devs = Vector{Float64}(undef, length(include_idxs))
    for (i, idx) in enumerate(include_idxs)
        devs[i] = LinearAlgebra.norm(aligned[idx, :] .- gt[idx, :])
    end
    return devs
end

function rmsd_from_coords(decoy::Array{Float64,2}, gt::Array{Float64,2}, align_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing; arch::Union{TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus, Nothing}=nothing)::Float64
    devs = deviations_from_coords(decoy, gt, align_idxs, include_idxs, arch=arch)
    return sqrt(mean(devs .^ 2))
end

function _one_hot_int(x::AbstractArray{<:Integer}, K::Int)
    sz = (size(x, 1), size(x, 2), K)
    out = zeros(Float32, sz)
    for i in axes(x, 1), j in axes(x, 2)
        v = x[i, j]
        if 1 <= v <= K
            out[i, j, v] = 1.0f0
        end
    end
    return out
end

function _per_atom_conditioning(
    arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus,
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig, 
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights
)::Tuple{Array{Float32,3}, Array{Float32,4}}
    c = config
    pos = batch["ref_structure"]["positions"]::Array{Float32,3}
    mask = batch["ref_structure"]["mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    elem = batch["ref_structure"]["element"]::Array{Int32,2}
    charge = batch["ref_structure"]["charge"]::Array{Float32,2}
    atom_name_chars = batch["ref_structure"]["atom_name_chars"]::Array{Int32,3}
    B, A = size(pos, 1), size(pos, 2)
    C = c.per_atom_channels
    PCP = c.per_atom_pair_channels
    if size(weights.Wp) != (3, C) || size(weights.Wm) != (1, C) || size(weights.We) != (128, C) || size(weights.Wc) != (1, C)
        error("Single-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_channels")
    end
    if size(weights.Wn, 1) != size(atom_name_chars, 3) || size(weights.Wn, 2) != C
        error("Wn shape must be (atom_name_chars, per_atom_channels)")
    end
    if size(weights.Wr) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wc2) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wo) != (3, PCP) || size(weights.wd) != (1, 1, 1, PCP)
        error("Pair-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_pair_channels")
    end
    
    act_shape = (B, A, C)
    act = arch.cxl_3_0_fabric(
        arch.hbm_koordinator, arch.pmem_motor, arch.szintelt_memoria_runtime,
        arch.cxl_best_shot, arch.ml_elolvaso, arch.dcchp_protokoll,
        arch.cache_megkerules, act_shape, Float32
    )

    act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", convert(Array{Float32}, pos), weights.Wp; precision=F32_F32)
    act .+= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wm, 1, 1, :)
    
    one_hot = _one_hot_int(elem, 128)
    act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", one_hot, weights.We; precision=F32_F32)
    
    act .+= reshape(charge, B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wc, 1, 1, :)
    
    act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", convert(Array{Float32}, atom_name_chars), weights.Wn; precision=F32_F32)
    
    act .*= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1)
    
    row_act = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", max.(act, 0), weights.Wr; precision=F32_F32)
    col_act = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", max.(act, 0), weights.Wc2; precision=F32_F32)

    pair_act_shape = (B, A, A, PCP)
    pair_act = arch.cxl_3_0_fabric(
        arch.hbm_koordinator, arch.pmem_motor, arch.szintelt_memoria_runtime,
        arch.cxl_best_shot, arch.ml_elolvaso, arch.dcchp_protokoll,
        arch.cache_megkerules, pair_act_shape, Float32
    )

    pair_act .= reshape(row_act, B, A, 1, PCP) .+ reshape(col_act, B, 1, A, PCP)
    
    offsets = reshape(pos, B, A, 1, 3) .- reshape(pos, B, 1, A, 3)
    pair_act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bijd,dk->bijk", offsets, weights.Wo; precision=F32_F32)

    sq_dists = sum(offsets .* offsets; dims=4)
    pair_act .+= (1.0f0 ./ (1.0f0 .+ sq_dists)) .* weights.wd
    
    return act, pair_act
end

function _choose_heads(channels::Int)
    for h in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1)
        if channels % h == 0
            return h, div(channels, h)
        end
    end
    return 1, channels
end

function _split_heads(x::Array{Float32,3}, h::Int)
    B, A, C = size(x)
    if C % h != 0
        error("Channels not divisible by heads")
    end
    d = div(C, h)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h, d)
end

function _merge_heads(x::Array{Float32,4})

    return reshape(x, B, A, h*d)

function atom_cross_att_encoder(
    arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus,
    token_atoms_act::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_single_cond::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_pair_cond::Union{Array{Float32,4}, Nothing},
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    name::String
)::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput
    c = config
    
    token_atoms_single_cond, pair_act = _per_atom_conditioning(arch, config, batch, weights)
    
    token_atoms_mask = batch["predicted_structure_info"]["atom_mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    queries_single_cond = token_atoms_single_cond
    queries_mask = reshape(token_atoms_mask, size(token_atoms_mask,1), size(token_atoms_mask,2), 1)
    
    if trunk_single_cond !== nothing
        if weights.Ws_trunk_single === nothing
            error("Ws_trunk_single must be provided when trunk_single_cond is not nothing")
        end
        if size(trunk_single_cond, 3) != size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 1) || size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 2) != c.per_atom_channels
            error("Ws_trunk_single shape is incompatible with trunk_single_cond or per_atom_channels")
        end
        
        trunk_calc = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", trunk_single_cond, weights.Ws_trunk_single; precision=F32_F32)
        queries_single_cond .+= trunk_calc
    end
    
    queries_act = token_atoms_act === nothing ? queries_single_cond : begin
        if size(token_atoms_act, 3) != c.per_atom_channels
            error("token_atoms_act last dim must equal per_atom_channels")
        end
        tmp = copy(token_atoms_act)
        tmp .*= queries_mask
        tmp .+= queries_single_cond
        tmp
    end
    
    keys_single_cond = queries_single_cond
    keys_mask = queries_mask
    
    if trunk_pair_cond !== nothing
        if size(trunk_pair_cond) != size(pair_act)
            error("trunk_pair_cond and computed pair_act shapes must match for addition")
        end
        pair_act .+= trunk_pair_cond
    end
    
    h, d = _choose_heads(c.per_atom_channels)
    
    q_gnn = arch.gnn_gyorsito(queries_act, pair_act)
    k_gnn = arch.gnn_gyorsito(keys_single_cond, pair_act)
    v_gnn = arch.gnn_gyorsito(queries_act, pair_act)

    q = _split_heads(q_gnn, h)
    k = _split_heads(k_gnn, h)
    v = _split_heads(v_gnn, h)

    local out
    arch.scu_egyseg() do 
        out = _attend(arch, q, k, v;
            q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32,
            logits_dtype=Float32,
            logits_scale=1.0,
            bias=nothing,
            mask=nothing,
            weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32
        )
    end
    
    out = out .* queries_mask
    out_merged = _merge_heads(out)
    
    skip_connection_data = arch.zero_copy_serializalo(out_merged)
    skip_connection_compressed = arch.fpga_huffman(skip_connection_data, arch.ldpc_kodek)
    skip_connection = skip_connection_compressed 

    if size(weights.Wt_token_out) != (c.per_atom_channels, c.per_token_channels)
        error("Wt_token_out shape must be (per_atom_channels, per_token_channels)")
    end
    
    token_atoms_act2 = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", out_merged, weights.Wt_token_out; precision=F32_F32)
    
    token_act_raw = mask_mean(queries_mask, max.(token_atoms_act2, 0f0); axis=2, keepdims=true)
    
    token_act = arch.gpu_direct_rpc(
        arch.aszinkron_kollektiv,
        arch.noma_link,
        arch.dpu_smartnic,
        token_act_raw
    )
    
    return AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput(
        token_act,
        skip_connection,
        queries_mask,
        queries_single_cond,
        keys_mask,
        keys_single_cond,
        pair_act
    )
end

function _futtat_optimalizalt_softmax(arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus, x::AbstractArray)
    ax = ndims(x)
    x32 = convert(Array{Float32}, x)
    x_max = maximum(x32; dims=ax)
    unnormalized = exp.(x32 .- x_max)
    denom = sum(unnormalized; dims=ax)
    return unnormalized ./ denom
end

function _attend(
    arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus,
    q::AbstractArray,
    k::AbstractArray,
    v::AbstractArray;
    q_k_dot_precision::DotPrecision,
    logits_dtype::DataType,
    logits_scale::Float64,
    bias::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing},
    mask::Union{Mask, Nothing},
    weights_v_dot_precision::DotPrecision,
    q_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing,
    k_indices::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}=nothing
)
    logits = arch.asadi_pim(
        arch.salo_asic,
        arch.rt_kernel,
        arch.pic_gyorsito,
        arch.aimc_tomb,
        arch.alpha_tensor,
        arch.kvantum_hid,
        arch.adaptiv_kvantalas,
        "...qhd,...khd->...hqk",
        q, k;
        precision=q_k_dot_precision
    )

    logits = convert(Array{logits_dtype}, logits)
    logits = logits .* logits_scale
    if bias !== nothing
        logits = logits .+ bias
    end
    if mask !== nothing
        q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2)
        k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
        mask_arr = as_array(mask, q_len, k_len)
        mask_value = -Inf32
        logits = ifelse.(mask_arr, logits, mask_value)
    end
    
    weights = _futtat_optimalizalt_softmax(arch, logits)
    weights = convert(Array{eltype(v)}, weights)
    
    out = arch.asadi_pim(
        arch.salo_asic,
        arch.rt_kernel,
        arch.pic_gyorsito,
        arch.aimc_tomb,
        arch.alpha_tensor,
        arch.kvantum_hid,
        arch.adaptiv_kvantalas,
        "...hqk,...khd->...qhd",
        weights, v;
        precision=weights_v_dot_precision
    )

    out = convert(Array{eltype(q)}, out)
    return out
end

function einsum(subscript::String, arrays::AbstractArray...)
    if subscript == "...qhd,...khd->...hqk"
        return compute_attention_scores(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    elseif subscript == "...hqk,...khd->...qhd"
        return compute_attention_output(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    else
        error("Unsupported einsum operation: $subscript")
    end
end

function _leading_shape(x::AbstractArray, last_nd::Int)
    nd = ndims(x)
    if nd < last_nd
        error("Tensor has fewer than $(last_nd) dims")
    end
    return Tuple(size(x)[1:nd-last_nd])
end

function _prod_shape(t::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    p = 1
    for v in t
        p *= v
    end
    return p
end

function compute_attention_scores(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(q) < 3 || ndims(k) < 3
        error("q and k must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(q, 3) != _leading_shape(k, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    qh = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    kh = size(k, ndims(k)-1)
    if qh != kh
        error("Head dimension must match between q and k")
    end
    dd = size(q, ndims(q))
    if dd != size(k, ndims(k))
        error("Feature dimension d must match between q and k")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(q, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2)
    k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
    h = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    d = size(q, ndims(q))
    q_ = reshape(q, (B, q_len, h, d))
    k_ = reshape(k, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    q2 = reshape(permutedims(q_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, q_len, d))
    k2 = reshape(permutedims(k_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    scores = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, k_len)
    for i in 1:BH
        scores[i, :, :] = convert(Array{Float32}, q2[i, :, :]) * transpose(convert(Array{Float32}, k2[i, :, :]))
    end
    out = reshape(scores, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., h, q_len, k_len))
end

function compute_attention_output(weights::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(weights) < 3 || ndims(v) < 3
        error("weights and v must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(weights, 3) != _leading_shape(v, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    h1 = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    h2 = size(v, ndims(v)-1)
    if h1 != h2
        error("Head dimension must match between weights and v")
    end
    k1 = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    k2 = size(v, ndims(v)-2)
    if k1 != k2
        error("Key length must match between weights and v")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(weights, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    h = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    q_len = size(weights, ndims(weights)-1)
    k_len = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    d = size(v, ndims(v))
    w_ = reshape(weights, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    v_ = reshape(v, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    w2 = reshape(permutedims(w_, (1, 2, 3, 4)), (BH, q_len, k_len))
    v2 = reshape(permutedims(v_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    out2 = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, d)
    for i in 1:BH
        out2[i, :, :] = convert(Array{Float32}, w2[i, :, :]) * convert(Array{Float32}, v2[i, :, :])
    end
    out = reshape(out2, (B, h, q_len, d))
    out = permutedims(out, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., q_len, h, d))
end

            value = convert(Array{Float32}, value)

end

function mask_mean(mask, value; axis=nothing, keepdims=true, eps=1e-10)
    ax = axis === nothing ? collect(1:ndims(value)) : axis
    if ax isa Integer
        ax = (ax,)
    elseif ax isa AbstractVector{<:Integer}
        ax = Tuple(ax)
    elseif !(ax isa Tuple)
        error("axis must be Integer, Vector or Tuple")
    end
    masked = value .* mask
    num = sum(masked; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)
    den = sum(mask; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)
    den = max.(den, eps)
    return num ./ den
end

struct Vec3Array
    x::Array{Float32}
    y::Array{Float32}
    z::Array{Float32}
    function Vec3Array(x, y, z)
        if eltype(x) !== eltype(y) || eltype(y) !== eltype(z)
            error("Type mismatch")
        end
        if size(x) != size(y) || size(y) != size(z)
            error("Shape mismatch")
        end

    end
end

function cross(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array)
    x = a.y .* b.z .- a.z .* b.y
    y = a.z .* b.x .- a.x .* b.z
    z = a.x .* b.y .- a.y .* b.x
    return Vec3Array(x, y, z)
end

function dot(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array)
    return a.x .* b.x .+ a.y .* b.y .+ a.z .* b.z
end

function norm(v::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)
    n2 = dot(v, v)
    if epsilon > 0
        n2 = max.(n2, epsilon^2)
    end
    return sqrt.(n2)
end

function norm2(v::Vec3Array)
    return dot(v, v)
end

function normalized(v::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)
    return v ./ norm(v, epsilon)
end

function to_array(v::Vec3Array)
    nd = ndims(v.x)
    return cat(v.x, v.y, v.z; dims=nd+1)
end

function from_array(a::AbstractArray)
    nd = ndims(a)
    if nd == 2
        return Vec3Array(a[:, 1], a[:, 2], a[:, 3])
    elseif nd == 3
        return Vec3Array(a[:, :, 1], a[:, :, 2], a[:, :, 3])
    else
        error("Unsupported array dims: $(nd)")
    end
end

function square_euclidean_distance(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)
    d = a - b
    dist = dot(d, d)
    if epsilon > 0
        dist = max.(dist, epsilon)
    end
    return dist
end

function euclidean_distance(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, epsilon::Float32=1f-6)
    dsq = square_euclidean_distance(a, b, epsilon^2)
    return sqrt.(dsq)
end

function dihedral_angle(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, c::Vec3Array, d::Vec3Array)
    v1 = a - b
    v2 = b - c
    v3 = d - c
    c1 = cross(v1, v2)
    c2 = cross(v3, v2)
    c3 = cross(c2, c1)
    v2m = norm(v2)
    return atan.(dot(c3, v2), v2m .* dot(c1, c2))
end

function _one_hot_int(x::AbstractArray{<:Integer}, K::Int)
    sz = (size(x, 1), size(x, 2), K)
    out = zeros(Float32, sz)
    for i in axes(x, 1), j in axes(x, 2)
        v = x[i, j]
        if 1 <= v <= K
            out[i, j, v] = 1.0f0
        end
    end
    return out
end

function _per_atom_conditioning(
    arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus,
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig, 
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights
)::Tuple{Array{Float32,3}, Array{Float32,4}}
    c = config
    pos = batch["ref_structure"]["positions"]::Array{Float32,3}
    mask = batch["ref_structure"]["mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    elem = batch["ref_structure"]["element"]::Array{Int32,2}
    charge = batch["ref_structure"]["charge"]::Array{Float32,2}
    atom_name_chars = batch["ref_structure"]["atom_name_chars"]::Array{Int32,3}
    B, A = size(pos, 1), size(pos, 2)
    C = c.per_atom_channels
    PCP = c.per_atom_pair_channels
    if size(weights.Wp) != (3, C) || size(weights.Wm) != (1, C) || size(weights.We) != (128, C) || size(weights.Wc) != (1, C)
        error("Single-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_channels")
    end
    if size(weights.Wn, 1) != size(atom_name_chars, 3) || size(weights.Wn, 2) != C
        error("Wn shape must be (atom_name_chars, per_atom_channels)")
    end
    if size(weights.Wr) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wc2) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wo) != (3, PCP) || size(weights.wd) != (1, 1, 1, PCP)
        error("Pair-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_pair_channels")
    end
    
    act_shape = (B, A, C)
    act = arch.cxl_3_0_fabric(
        arch.hbm_koordinator, arch.pmem_motor, arch.szintelt_memoria_runtime,
        arch.cxl_best_shot, arch.ml_elolvaso, arch.dcchp_protokoll,
        arch.cache_megkerules, act_shape, Float32
    )

    act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", convert(Array{Float32}, pos), weights.Wp; precision=F32_F32)
    act .+= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wm, 1, 1, :)
    
    one_hot = _one_hot_int(elem, 128)
    act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", one_hot, weights.We; precision=F32_F32)
    
    act .+= reshape(charge, B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wc, 1, 1, :)
    
    act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", convert(Array{Float32}, atom_name_chars), weights.Wn; precision=F32_F32)
    
    act .*= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1)
    
    row_act = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", max.(act, 0), weights.Wr; precision=F32_F32)
    col_act = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", max.(act, 0), weights.Wc2; precision=F32_F32)

    pair_act_shape = (B, A, A, PCP)
    pair_act = arch.cxl_3_0_fabric(
        arch.hbm_koordinator, arch.pmem_motor, arch.szintelt_memoria_runtime,
        arch.cxl_best_shot, arch.ml_elolvaso, arch.dcchp_protokoll,
        arch.cache_megkerules, pair_act_shape, Float32
    )

    pair_act .= reshape(row_act, B, A, 1, PCP) .+ reshape(col_act, B, 1, A, PCP)
    
    offsets = reshape(pos, B, A, 1, 3) .- reshape(pos, B, 1, A, 3)
    pair_act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bijd,dk->bijk", offsets, weights.Wo; precision=F32_F32)

    sq_dists = sum(offsets .* offsets; dims=4)
    pair_act .+= (1.0f0 ./ (1.0f0 .+ sq_dists)) .* weights.wd
    
    return act, pair_act
end

function _choose_heads(channels::Int)
    for h in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1)
        if channels % h == 0
            return h, div(channels, h)
        end
    end
    return 1, channels
end

function _split_heads(x::Array{Float32,3}, h::Int)
    B, A, C = size(x)
    if C % h != 0
        error("Channels not divisible by heads")
    end
    d = div(C, h)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h, d)
end

function _merge_heads(x::Array{Float32,4})

    return reshape(x, B, A, h*d)

    arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus,
    token_atoms_act::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_single_cond::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_pair_cond::Union{Array{Float32,4}, Nothing},
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any},

    token_atoms_single_cond, pair_act = _per_atom_conditioning(arch, config, batch, weights)
    
    token_atoms_mask = batch["predicted_structure_info"]["atom_mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    queries_single_cond = token_atoms_single_cond
    queries_mask = reshape(token_atoms_mask, size(token_atoms_mask,1), size(token_atoms_mask,2), 1)

        if weights.Ws_trunk_single === nothing
            error("Ws_trunk_single must be provided when trunk_single_cond is not nothing")

        if size(trunk_single_cond, 3) != size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 1) || size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 2) != c.per_atom_channels

        trunk_calc = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", trunk_single_cond, weights.Ws_trunk_single; precision=F32_F32)

        if size(token_atoms_act, 3) != c.per_atom_channels

    end

    skip_connection_compressed = arch.fpga_huffman(skip_connection_data, arch.ldpc_kodek)
    skip_connection = skip_connection_compressed

        token_act,

    )

    logits_dtype::DataType,

function einsum(subscript::String, arrays::AbstractArray...)
    if subscript == "...qhd,...khd->...hqk"
        return compute_attention_scores(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    elseif subscript == "...hqk,...khd->...qhd"
        return compute_attention_output(arrays[1], arrays[2])
    elseif subscript == "ij,ik->jk"
        A, B = arrays
        if ndims(A) != 2 || ndims(B) != 2
            error("ij,ik->jk expects 2D inputs")
        end
        if size(A, 1) != size(B, 1)
            error("Dimension mismatch on i")
        end
        return transpose(A) * B
    elseif subscript == "ij,jk->ik"
        A, B = arrays
        if ndims(A) != 2 || ndims(B) != 2
            error("ij,jk->ik expects 2D inputs")
        end
        if size(A, 2) != size(B, 1)
            error("Dimension mismatch on j")
        end
        return A * B
    elseif subscript == "bac,cd->bad"
        X, W = arrays
        if ndims(X) != 3 || ndims(W) != 2
            error("bac,cd->bad expects X as 3D, W as 2D")
        end
        if size(X, 3) != size(W, 1)
            error("Dimension mismatch on c")
        end
        B, A, C = size(X)
        D = size(W, 2)
        X2 = reshape(X, B*A, C)
        Y2 = X2 * W
        return reshape(Y2, B, A, D)
    elseif subscript == "bijd,dk->bijk"
        X, W = arrays
        if ndims(X) != 4 || ndims(W) != 2
            error("bijd,dk->bijk expects X as 4D, W as 2D")
        end
        if size(X, 4) != size(W, 1)
            error("Dimension mismatch on d")
        end
        B, I, J, D = size(X)
        K = size(W, 2)
        X2 = reshape(X, B*I*J, D)
        Y2 = X2 * W
        return reshape(Y2, B, I, J, K)
    else
        error("Unsupported einsum operation: $subscript")
    end
end

function _leading_shape(x::AbstractArray, last_nd::Int)
    nd = ndims(x)
    if nd < last_nd
        error("Tensor has fewer than $(last_nd) dims")
    end
    return Tuple(size(x)[1:nd-last_nd])
end

function _prod_shape(t::Tuple{Vararg{Int}})
    p = 1
    for v in t
        p *= v
    end
    return p
end

function compute_attention_scores(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(q) < 3 || ndims(k) < 3
        error("q and k must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(q, 3) != _leading_shape(k, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    qh = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    kh = size(k, ndims(k)-1)
    if qh != kh
        error("Head dimension must match between q and k")
    end
    dd = size(q, ndims(q))
    if dd != size(k, ndims(k))
        error("Feature dimension d must match between q and k")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(q, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    q_len = size(q, ndims(q)-2)
    k_len = size(k, ndims(k)-2)
    h = size(q, ndims(q)-1)
    d = size(q, ndims(q))
    q_ = reshape(q, (B, q_len, h, d))
    k_ = reshape(k, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    q2 = reshape(permutedims(q_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, q_len, d))
    k2 = reshape(permutedims(k_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    scores = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, k_len)
    for i in 1:BH
        scores[i, :, :] = convert(Array{Float32}, q2[i, :, :]) * transpose(convert(Array{Float32}, k2[i, :, :]))
    end
    out = reshape(scores, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., h, q_len, k_len))
end

function compute_attention_output(weights::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray)
    if ndims(weights) < 3 || ndims(v) < 3
        error("weights and v must be at least 3D")
    end
    if _leading_shape(weights, 3) != _leading_shape(v, 3)
        error("Leading shapes must match")
    end
    h1 = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    h2 = size(v, ndims(v)-1)
    if h1 != h2
        error("Head dimension must match between weights and v")
    end
    k1 = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    k2 = size(v, ndims(v)-2)
    if k1 != k2
        error("Key length must match between weights and v")
    end
    lead = _leading_shape(weights, 3)
    B = max(_prod_shape(lead), 1)
    h = size(weights, ndims(weights)-2)
    q_len = size(weights, ndims(weights)-1)
    k_len = size(weights, ndims(weights))
    d = size(v, ndims(v))
    w_ = reshape(weights, (B, h, q_len, k_len))
    v_ = reshape(v, (B, k_len, h, d))
    BH = B * h
    w2 = reshape(permutedims(w_, (1, 2, 3, 4)), (BH, q_len, k_len))
    v2 = reshape(permutedims(v_, (1, 3, 2, 4)), (BH, k_len, d))
    out2 = Array{Float32}(undef, BH, q_len, d)
    for i in 1:BH
        out2[i, :, :] = convert(Array{Float32}, w2[i, :, :]) * convert(Array{Float32}, v2[i, :, :])
    end
    out = reshape(out2, (B, h, q_len, d))
    out = permutedims(out, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    return reshape(out, (lead..., q_len, h, d))
end

function mask_mean(mask, value; axis=nothing, keepdims=true, eps=1e-10)
    ax = axis === nothing ? collect(1:ndims(value)) : axis
    if ax isa Integer
        ax = (ax,)
    elseif ax isa AbstractVector{<:Integer}
        ax = Tuple(ax)
    elseif !(ax isa Tuple)
        error("axis must be Integer, Vector or Tuple")
    end
    masked = value .* mask
    num = sum(masked; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)
    den = sum(mask; dims=ax, keepdims=keepdims)
    den = max.(den, eps)
    return num ./ den
end

function cross(a::Vec3Array{T}, b::Vec3Array{T}) where {T}
    x = a.y .* b.z .- a.z .* b.y
    y = a.z .* b.x .- a.x .* b.z
    z = a.x .* b.y .- a.y .* b.x
    return Vec3Array{typeof(x[begin])}(x, y, z)
end

    end
    return sqrt.(n2)

function dihedral_angle(a::Vec3Array{T}, b::Vec3Array{T}, c::Vec3Array{T}, d::Vec3Array{T}) where {T<:Real}
    v1 = a - b
    v2 = b - c
    v3 = d - c
    c1 = cross(v1, v2)
    c2 = cross(v3, v2)
    c3 = cross(c2, c1)
    v2m = norm(v2)
    return atan.(dot(c3, v2), v2m .* dot(c1, c2))
end

    if size(x, 2) != 3 || size(y, 2) != 3
        error("x and y must be N x 3")
    end
    if size(x, 1) != size(y, 1)
        error("x and y must have same number of points")
    end
    local c
    if arch !== nothing
        c_raw = arch.pic_gyorsito(
            arch.aimc_tomb,
            arch.alpha_tensor,
            arch.kvantum_hid,
            "ij,ik->jk",
            transpose(x), y
        )
        c = convert(Array{Float64}, c_raw)
    else
        c = x' * y
    end
    F = svd(c)
    U = F.U
    V = F.Vt'
    R = V * U'
    if !allow_reflection && det(R) < 0
        V[:, end] .*= -1.0
        R = V * U'
    end
    return R
end

function align(; x::Array{Float64,2}, y::Array{Float64,2}, x_indices::Vector{Int}, y_indices::Vector{Int}, arch::Union{TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus, Nothing}=nothing)::Array{Float64,2}
    if length(x_indices) != length(y_indices)
        throw(ArgumentError("Number of indices must match"))
    end
    x_mean = mean(x[x_indices, :]; dims=1)
    y_mean = mean(y[y_indices, :]; dims=1)
    cx = x .- x_mean
    cy = y .- y_mean
    R = transform_ls(cx[x_indices, :], cy[y_indices, :], arch=arch)
    local tx
    if arch !== nothing
        cx_r_raw = arch.pic_gyorsito(
            arch.aimc_tomb,
            arch.alpha_tensor,
            arch.kvantum_hid,
            "ij,jk->ik",
            cx, R
        )
        tx_raw = convert(Array{Float64}, cx_r_raw)
        tx = tx_raw .+ y_mean
    else
        tx = cx * R .+ y_mean
    end
    return tx
end

function deviations_from_coords(decoy::Array{Float64,2}, gt::Array{Float64,2}, align_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing; arch::Union{TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus, Nothing}=nothing)::Vector{Float64}
    if size(decoy) != size(gt)
        throw(ArgumentError("decoy and gt shapes must match"))
    end
    if include_idxs === nothing
        include_idxs = collect(1:size(decoy, 1))
    end
    if align_idxs === nothing
        align_idxs = include_idxs
    end
    aligned = align(x=decoy, y=gt, x_indices=align_idxs, y_indices=align_idxs, arch=arch)
    devs = Vector{Float64}(undef, length(include_idxs))
    for (i, idx) in enumerate(include_idxs)
        devs[i] = LinearAlgebra.norm(aligned[idx, :] .- gt[idx, :])
    end
    return devs
end

function rmsd_from_coords(decoy::Array{Float64,2}, gt::Array{Float64,2}, align_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing, include_idxs::Union{Vector{Int},Nothing}=nothing; arch::Union{TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus, Nothing}=nothing)::Float64
    devs = deviations_from_coords(decoy, gt, align_idxs, include_idxs, arch=arch)
    return sqrt(mean(devs .^ 2))
end

function _one_hot_int(x::AbstractArray{<:Integer}, K::Int)
    sz = (size(x, 1), size(x, 2), K)
    out = zeros(Float32, sz)
    for i in axes(x, 1), j in axes(x, 2)
        v = x[i, j]
        if 1 <= v <= K
            out[i, j, v] = 1.0f0
        end
    end
    return out
end

function _per_atom_conditioning(
    arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus,
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig, 
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights
)::Tuple{Array{Float32,3}, Array{Float32,4}}
    c = config
    pos = batch["ref_structure"]["positions"]::Array{Float32,3}
    mask = batch["ref_structure"]["mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    elem = batch["ref_structure"]["element"]::Array{Int32,2}
    charge = batch["ref_structure"]["charge"]::Array{Float32,2}
    atom_name_chars = batch["ref_structure"]["atom_name_chars"]::Array{Int32,3}
    B, A = size(pos, 1), size(pos, 2)
    C = c.per_atom_channels
    PCP = c.per_atom_pair_channels
    if size(weights.Wp) != (3, C) || size(weights.Wm) != (1, C) || size(weights.We) != (128, C) || size(weights.Wc) != (1, C)
        error("Single-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_channels")
    end
    if size(weights.Wn, 1) != size(atom_name_chars, 3) || size(weights.Wn, 2) != C
        error("Wn shape must be (atom_name_chars, per_atom_channels)")
    end
    if size(weights.Wr) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wc2) != (C, PCP) || size(weights.Wo) != (3, PCP) || size(weights.wd) != (1, 1, 1, PCP)
        error("Pair-conditioning weight shapes are inconsistent with per_atom_pair_channels")
    end
    act_shape = (B, A, C)
    act = arch.cxl_3_0_fabric(
        arch.hbm_koordinator, arch.pmem_motor, arch.szintelt_memoria_runtime,
        arch.cxl_best_shot, arch.ml_elolvaso, arch.dcchp_protokoll,
        arch.cache_megkerules, act_shape, Float32
    )
    act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", convert(Array{Float32}, pos), weights.Wp; precision=F32_F32)
    act .+= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wm, 1, 1, :)
    one_hot = _one_hot_int(elem, 128)
    act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", one_hot, weights.We; precision=F32_F32)
    act .+= reshape(charge, B, A, 1) .* reshape(weights.Wc, 1, 1, :)
    act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", convert(Array{Float32}, atom_name_chars), weights.Wn; precision=F32_F32)
    act .*= reshape(convert(Array{Float32}, mask), B, A, 1)
    row_act = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", max.(act, 0), weights.Wr; precision=F32_F32)
    col_act = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", max.(act, 0), weights.Wc2; precision=F32_F32)
    pair_act_shape = (B, A, A, PCP)
    pair_act = arch.cxl_3_0_fabric(
        arch.hbm_koordinator, arch.pmem_motor, arch.szintelt_memoria_runtime,
        arch.cxl_best_shot, arch.ml_elolvaso, arch.dcchp_protokoll,
        arch.cache_megkerules, pair_act_shape, Float32
    )
    pair_act .= reshape(row_act, B, A, 1, PCP) .+ reshape(col_act, B, 1, A, PCP)
    offsets = reshape(pos, B, A, 1, 3) .- reshape(pos, B, 1, A, 3)
    pair_act .+= _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bijd,dk->bijk", offsets, weights.Wo; precision=F32_F32)
    sq_dists = sum(offsets .* offsets; dims=4)
    pair_act .+= (1.0f0 ./ (1.0f0 .+ sq_dists)) .* weights.wd
    return act, pair_act
end

function _choose_heads(channels::Int)
    for h in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1)
        if channels % h == 0
            return h, div(channels, h)
        end
    end
    return 1, channels
end

function _split_heads(x::Array{Float32,3}, h::Int)
    B, A, C = size(x)
    if C % h != 0
        error("Channels not divisible by heads")
    end
    d = div(C, h)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h, d)
end

function _merge_heads(x::Array{Float32,4})
    B, A, h, d = size(x)
    return reshape(x, B, A, h*d)
end

function atom_cross_att_encoder(
    arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus,
    token_atoms_act::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_single_cond::Union{Array{Float32,3}, Nothing},
    trunk_pair_cond::Union{Array{Float32,4}, Nothing},
    config::AtomCrossAttEncoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttEncoderWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    name::String
)::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput
    c = config
    token_atoms_single_cond, pair_act = _per_atom_conditioning(arch, config, batch, weights)
    token_atoms_mask = batch["predicted_structure_info"]["atom_mask"]::Array{Float32,2}
    queries_single_cond = token_atoms_single_cond
    queries_mask = reshape(token_atoms_mask, size(token_atoms_mask,1), size(token_atoms_mask,2), 1)
    if trunk_single_cond !== nothing
        if weights.Ws_trunk_single === nothing
            error("Ws_trunk_single must be provided when trunk_single_cond is not nothing")
        end
        if size(trunk_single_cond, 3) != size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 1) || size(weights.Ws_trunk_single, 2) != c.per_atom_channels
            error("Ws_trunk_single shape is incompatible with trunk_single_cond or per_atom_channels")
        end
        trunk_calc = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", trunk_single_cond, weights.Ws_trunk_single; precision=F32_F32)
        queries_single_cond .+= trunk_calc
    end
    queries_act = token_atoms_act === nothing ? queries_single_cond : begin
        if size(token_atoms_act, 3) != c.per_atom_channels
            error("token_atoms_act last dim must equal per_atom_channels")
        end
        tmp = copy(token_atoms_act)
        tmp .*= queries_mask
        tmp .+= queries_single_cond
        tmp
    end
    keys_single_cond = queries_single_cond
    keys_mask = queries_mask
    if trunk_pair_cond !== nothing
        if size(trunk_pair_cond) != size(pair_act)
            error("trunk_pair_cond and computed pair_act shapes must match for addition")
        end
        pair_act .+= trunk_pair_cond
    end
    h, d = _choose_heads(c.per_atom_channels)
    q_gnn = arch.gnn_gyorsito(queries_act, pair_act)
    k_gnn = arch.gnn_gyorsito(keys_single_cond, pair_act)
    v_gnn = arch.gnn_gyorsito(queries_act, pair_act)
    q = _split_heads(q_gnn, h)
    k = _split_heads(k_gnn, h)
    v = _split_heads(v_gnn, h)
    local out
    arch.scu_egyseg() do 
        out = _attend(arch, q, k, v;
            q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32,
            logits_dtype=Float32,
            logits_scale=1.0,
            bias=nothing,
            mask=nothing,
            weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32
        )
    end
    out = out .* queries_mask
    out_merged = _merge_heads(out)
    skip_connection_data = arch.zero_copy_serializalo(out_merged)
    skip_connection_compressed = arch.fpga_huffman(skip_connection_data, arch.ldpc_kodek)
    skip_connection = skip_connection_compressed 
    if size(weights.Wt_token_out) != (c.per_atom_channels, c.per_token_channels)
        error("Wt_token_out shape must be (per_atom_channels, per_token_channels)")
    end
    token_atoms_act2 = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", out_merged, weights.Wt_token_out; precision=F32_F32)
    token_act_raw = mask_mean(queries_mask, max.(token_atoms_act2, 0f0); axis=2, keepdims=true)
    token_act = arch.gpu_direct_rpc(
        arch.aszinkron_kollektiv,
        arch.noma_link,
        arch.dpu_smartnic,
        token_act_raw
    )
    return AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput(
        token_act,
        skip_connection,
        queries_mask,
        queries_single_cond,
        keys_mask,
        keys_single_cond,
        pair_act
    )
end

function atom_cross_att_decoder(
    arch::TeljesArchitekturaKonteextus,
    token_act::Array{Float32,3},
    enc::AtomCrossAttEncoderOutput,
    config::AtomCrossAttDecoderConfig,
    weights::AtomCrossAttDecoderWeights,
    batch::Dict{String, Any},
    name::String
)::Array{Float32,3}
    c = config
    if size(weights.Wp_token_to_atom, 1) != size(token_act, 3) || size(weights.Wp_token_to_atom, 2) != c.per_atom_channels
        error("Wp_token_to_atom shape must be (token_channels, per_atom_channels)")
    end
    token_act2 = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", token_act, weights.Wp_token_to_atom; precision=F32_F32)
    B = size(enc.queries_mask, 1)
    A = size(enc.queries_mask, 2)
    token_atom_act = repeat(token_act2, 1, A, 1)
    skip_connection_decompressed = arch.fpga_huffman(enc.skip_connection, arch.ldpc_kodek)
    skip_connection = arch.zero_copy_serializalo(skip_connection_decompressed)
    queries_act = token_atom_act .+ skip_connection
    queries_act .*= enc.queries_mask
    h, d = _choose_heads(c.per_atom_channels)
    q_gnn = arch.gnn_gyorsito(queries_act, enc.pair_cond)
    k_gnn = arch.gnn_gyorsito(enc.keys_single_cond, enc.pair_cond)
    v_gnn = arch.gnn_gyorsito(queries_act, enc.pair_cond)
    q = _split_heads(q_gnn, h)
    k = _split_heads(k_gnn, h)
    v = _split_heads(v_gnn, h)
    local out
    arch.scu_egyseg() do
        out = _attend(arch, q, k, v;
            q_k_dot_precision=F32_F32,
            logits_dtype=Float32,
            logits_scale=1.0,
            bias=nothing,
            mask=nothing,
            weights_v_dot_precision=F32_F32
        )
    end
    out .*= enc.queries_mask
    out_merged = _merge_heads(out)
    if size(weights.Wpos, 1) != size(out_merged, 3) || size(weights.Wpos, 2) != 3
        error("Wpos shape must be (per_atom_channels, 3)")
    end
    position_update_raw = _futtat_gyorsitott_einsum(arch, "bac,cd->bad", out_merged, weights.Wpos; precision=F32_F32)
    position_update_egdl = arch.egdl_architektura(position_update_raw)
    position_update_pinn = arch.pinn_approximacio(position_update_egdl)
    return position_update_pinn
end
